scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: the agent's reported dissociation activation energies are compared to the paper's Table 1 values with absolute tolerance 0.3 eV. Recomputing the energies from mean force data is infeasible because the agent only submits the final JSON.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold dissociation activation energies (Ed) from paper Table 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1: N-N_NaGa_Ed=1.13, C-C_NaGa_Ed=2.71, C-H_CH_NaGa_Ed=1.34, C-H_CH4_Ga_Ed=1.40.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's published values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported results; identical values are written by the reference solve.sh.

outputs.description: Activation free energies for bond formation (Ef) and dissociation (Ed) of N-N, C-C, C-H(CH) in Na-Ga melt and C-H(CH4) in Ga melt. The four dissociation energies (Ed) are scored; formation energies must be positive.

output_contract.notes: Scoring is based on the four dissociation activation energies (Ed) compared to reference values within an absolute tolerance. Formation energies (Ef) must be positive but are not scored.
